description:
Create a new product attribute in Magento admin. Go to Stores > Attributes > Product. Create an attribute with Default Label 'Material Origin' and Attribute Code 'material_origin'. Input Type must be 'Dropdown'. Add exactly these 5 options: 'Locally Sourced', 'Imported - Europe', 'Imported - Asia', 'Fair Trade Certified', 'Recycled/Upcycled'. 

Storefront Properties must be set to: Use in Search = Yes, Visible in Advanced Search = Yes, Comparable on Storefront = Yes, Use in Layered Navigation = Filterable (with results), Use in Search Results Layered Navigation = Yes.

CRITICAL STEP: After saving the attribute, you MUST assign it to the 'Default' Attribute Set (Stores > Attributes > Attribute Set). Move it from Unassigned to any group in the Default set and save.
